common_issues.pattern: useEffect without cleanup on async operations
common_issues.detection_hint: useEffect containing fetch/axios/async call, no cleanup function returned, no AbortController
common_issues.fix_template: Add a cleanup guard: useEffect(() => { let active = true; fetchData().then(d => { if (active) setData(d); }); return () => { active = false; }; }, []);

common_issues.pattern: missing key prop in list rendering
common_issues.detection_hint: .map() rendering JSX elements without a key attribute, or using array index as key when list order can change
common_issues.fix_template: Add key={item.id} using a stable unique identifier from the data, not the array index unless the list is static and never reordered

common_issues.pattern: direct state mutation instead of immutable update
common_issues.detection_hint: array.push()/splice() or direct object property assignment on a state variable, then calling setState with the same mutated reference
common_issues.fix_template: Use setState([...array, newItem]) for arrays or setState({...state, key: value}) for objects — always create a new reference

common_issues.pattern: inline object or function props causing unnecessary re-renders
common_issues.detection_hint: JSX passing style={{...}} or onClick={() => ...} inline to a memoized child component
common_issues.fix_template: Move the object/function outside the render or wrap with useMemo/useCallback if passed to a React.memo-wrapped child

common_issues.pattern: expensive computation in useState initial value re-run every render
common_issues.detection_hint: useState(expensiveFunction()) instead of useState(() => expensiveFunction())
common_issues.fix_template: Use lazy initialization: useState(() => expensiveFunction()) so it only runs once on mount

common_issues.pattern: conditional rendering with && showing literal 0
common_issues.detection_hint: {count && <Component />} where count can be the number 0, rendering a stray '0' in the DOM
common_issues.fix_template: Use {count > 0 && <Component />} or {Boolean(count) && <Component />} to avoid rendering falsy numbers

common_issues.pattern: stale closure from missing dependency in useEffect/useCallback
common_issues.detection_hint: useEffect or useCallback referencing a variable from outer scope not listed in the dependency array
common_issues.fix_template: Add the missing variable to the dependency array, or use a ref if the value should not trigger re-runs

common_issues.pattern: data fetching directly in component body instead of useEffect
common_issues.detection_hint: fetch() or axios call placed directly in the function component body, executing on every render
common_issues.fix_template: Move the fetch call inside useEffect(() => { ... }, [dependencies]) so it only runs when intended

common_issues.pattern: no loading or error state handling for async data
common_issues.detection_hint: component renders data directly from state that starts as null/undefined with no loading/error branch
common_issues.fix_template: Add isLoading and error state variables, render a loading indicator or error message before the data is ready

common_issues.pattern: form inputs without controlled value binding
common_issues.detection_hint: <input> with onChange handler but no value prop bound to state, or value prop without onChange (React warning)
common_issues.fix_template: Bind both value={state} and onChange={e => setState(e.target.value)} for fully controlled inputs

common_issues.pattern: using useEffect for data fetching instead of server-side fetch
common_issues.detection_hint: 'use client' component fetching data in useEffect when the data could be fetched server-side in a Server Component
common_issues.fix_template: Move data fetching to a Server Component using async/await directly in the component function, or use fetch() with Next.js caching

common_issues.pattern: missing 'use client' directive causing hydration errors
common_issues.detection_hint: component using useState/useEffect/onClick without 'use client' at the top of the file
common_issues.fix_template: Add 'use client'; as the first line of the file when the component uses hooks or browser-only APIs

common_issues.pattern: raw tag instead of next/image
common_issues.detection_hint: used directly instead of the Image component from 'next/image'
common_issues.fix_template: Replace with <Image src={...} width={} height={} alt={} /> from next/image for automatic optimization

common_issues.pattern: client-side environment variable missing NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix
common_issues.detection_hint: process.env.SOME_VAR referenced in a 'use client' component without the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix — will be undefined in the browser
common_issues.fix_template: Rename the env variable to NEXT_PUBLIC_SOME_VAR in .env and update all client-side references

common_issues.pattern: API route without HTTP method validation
common_issues.detection_hint: app/api/*/route.ts exporting a handler that processes the request without checking req.method, accepting any verb
common_issues.fix_template: Export separate named functions per method (GET, POST, etc.) as the App Router expects, rejecting unsupported methods automatically

common_issues.pattern: missing loading.tsx or error.tsx boundaries
common_issues.detection_hint: app directory route folder with page.tsx but no loading.tsx/error.tsx sibling for a data-fetching page
common_issues.fix_template: Add loading.tsx with a skeleton/spinner and error.tsx with a retry UI in the same route folder

common_issues.pattern: mutating a prop directly inside a child component
common_issues.detection_hint: component modifying a prop value directly instead of emitting an event to the parent
common_issues.fix_template: Emit an update event: emit('update:modelValue', newValue) and let the parent own the state change

common_issues.pattern: missing :key in v-for
common_issues.detection_hint: v-for directive rendering elements without a :key binding
common_issues.fix_template: Add :key="item.id" using a stable unique identifier, not the loop index for dynamic lists

common_issues.pattern: reactivity lost when destructuring a reactive object
common_issues.detection_hint: const { value } = reactive({...}) — destructured primitive loses its reactive connection
common_issues.fix_template: Use toRefs(reactiveObject) before destructuring, or access properties directly without destructuring

common_issues.pattern: watchEffect or watch without cleanup for subscriptions
common_issues.detection_hint: watchEffect containing a subscription/interval/listener setup with no onCleanup call
common_issues.fix_template: Use the onCleanup callback provided to watchEffect: watchEffect((onCleanup) => { const id = setInterval(...); onCleanup(() => clearInterval(id)); })

common_issues.pattern: v-html with unsanitized dynamic content
common_issues.detection_hint: v-html="userGeneratedContent" bound to data that originates from user input or an external API
common_issues.fix_template: Sanitize the HTML with a library like DOMPurify before binding, or avoid v-html and render as plain text with v-text

common_issues.pattern: missing responsive prefix on layout-critical classes
common_issues.detection_hint: flex-row, grid-cols-3, or fixed width classes with no sm:/md:/lg: variant, likely breaking on mobile viewports
common_issues.fix_template: Add responsive variants: flex-col md:flex-row, or grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 for mobile-first layout

common_issues.pattern: arbitrary values instead of theme scale
common_issues.detection_hint: classes like w-[347px], text-[#3a3a3a], p-[13px] instead of the predefined spacing/color scale
common_issues.fix_template: Prefer scale values like w-96, text-gray-700, p-3 unless the exact pixel value is a hard design requirement

common_issues.pattern: conflicting utility classes on the same element
common_issues.detection_hint: multiple classes affecting the same CSS property, e.g. both p-4 and px-2 py-6 on the same element causing unpredictable overrides
common_issues.fix_template: Consolidate to a single set of non-conflicting utility classes, remove the redundant/conflicting ones

common_issues.pattern: content paths misconfigured causing missing styles in production build
common_issues.detection_hint: tailwind.config.js content array not covering all directories where className strings are used (e.g. missing a components/ subfolder)
common_issues.fix_template: Ensure content includes all relevant paths: content: ['./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}', './components/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}']

common_issues.pattern: dark mode classes used without dark mode strategy configured
common_issues.detection_hint: dark: prefixed classes present in markup but darkMode option not set in tailwind.config.js (defaults may not match intended behavior)
common_issues.fix_template: Set darkMode: 'class' in tailwind.config.js and toggle a 'dark' class on the html/body element via JS to control dark mode explicitly

common_issues.pattern: overusing @apply creating unmaintainable custom classes
common_issues.detection_hint: large custom CSS classes built entirely from @apply chains that duplicate what utility classes already do inline
common_issues.fix_template: Prefer applying utility classes directly in markup; reserve @apply for genuinely reused, complex component patterns only

common_issues.pattern: custom CSS fighting Bootstrap specificity
common_issues.detection_hint: !important overrides or deeply nested selectors attempting to override .btn, .card, .navbar default styles
common_issues.fix_template: Use Bootstrap's CSS custom properties (--bs-btn-bg, --bs-card-border-color, etc.) or utility classes instead of !important overrides

common_issues.pattern: missing viewport meta tag breaking responsive grid
common_issues.detection_hint: <meta name="viewport"...> absent from <head>, causing Bootstrap's responsive breakpoints to behave incorrectly on mobile
common_issues.fix_template: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the document head

common_issues.pattern: incorrect grid gutter usage causing overflow
common_issues.detection_hint: row/col classes used without a containing .container or .row wrapper, or nested rows without proper col padding offset
common_issues.fix_template: Ensure every .row is inside a .container or .container-fluid, and every direct child of .row is a .col-* class

common_issues.pattern: deprecated Bootstrap 4 classes used in a Bootstrap 5 project
common_issues.detection_hint: classes like .form-group, .badge-primary, .ml-2/.mr-2 (Bootstrap 4) present alongside a Bootstrap 5 CDN/package import
common_issues.fix_template: Update to Bootstrap 5 equivalents: .mb-3 instead of .form-group spacing, .text-bg-primary instead of .badge-primary, .ms-2/.me-2 instead of .ml-2/.mr-2

common_issues.pattern: innerHTML assignment with unsanitized user input
common_issues.detection_hint: element.innerHTML = variable where the variable originates from user input, URL params, or an API response
common_issues.fix_template: Use element.textContent for plain text, or sanitize with DOMPurify.sanitize() before assigning to innerHTML if markup is required

common_issues.pattern: event listener added repeatedly without removal causing memory leak
common_issues.detection_hint: addEventListener called inside a function that runs multiple times (e.g. on every render/update) without a matching removeEventListener
common_issues.fix_template: Store the handler function reference and call removeEventListener with that same reference before adding it again, or use event delegation on a parent element

common_issues.pattern: global variable pollution
common_issues.detection_hint: variables declared without let/const/var at the top level, implicitly attaching to the global window object
common_issues.fix_template: Wrap code in a module (type="module" script tag) or an IIFE, and always declare variables with let/const

common_issues.pattern: querySelector called repeatedly inside a loop
common_issues.detection_hint: document.querySelector or getElementById called multiple times for the same element inside a loop or frequently-called function
common_issues.fix_template: Cache the element reference in a variable outside the loop and reuse it

common_issues.pattern: z-index war with arbitrarily large values
common_issues.detection_hint: z-index values like 9999, 99999, or higher scattered across the CSS without a defined stacking system
common_issues.fix_template: Define a small set of z-index tokens (e.g. --z-dropdown: 10, --z-modal: 100, --z-toast: 1000) and use only those consistently

common_issues.pattern: float-based layout instead of flexbox or grid
common_issues.detection_hint: float: left/right combined with clearfix hacks used for multi-column layout
common_issues.fix_template: Replace float-based layout with display: flex or display: grid on the parent container — removes the need for clearfix entirely

common_issues.pattern: missing box-sizing border-box causing sizing bugs
common_issues.detection_hint: elements with both width and padding/border set, no box-sizing: border-box declared anywhere in the stylesheet
common_issues.fix_template: Add a global reset: *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; } near the top of the main stylesheet

common_issues.pattern: blocking synchronous script tags without defer or async
common_issues.detection_hint: <script src="..."> tags in <head> without defer or async attribute, blocking page render
common_issues.fix_template: Add the defer attribute for scripts that need the DOM but don't need to run immediately: <script src="..." defer></script>
